slides.texte_overlay:
“i always start studying
the night before”
same. here's what changed it for me:

i set my own deadline 3 days before the real one.
and i treat it as real.

the first step is tiny on purpose.
open the notebook. read one page.
2 minutes rule: if it takes less, i do it now.

my phone time became learning time.
5 minutes of a short lesson before any scrolling.
